name: studio
description: New videos with no footage of your own: a fully animated video from a text prompt (a script in scenes, an animation per scene, and any of an AI voiceover, on-screen text and music), and the best moments of long streams and gameplay videos as short clips with a facecam layout, captions, a cover image and a post caption; a long researched video from one prompt with found footage, pictures and graphics; UGC-style ads cut from filmed clips with different hooks; and subtitle files in other languages for any finished video. Uses the ai-editor plugin's animation, sound, transcription and renderer.
